reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount (duplicate-link check, upgrade/create, initial sync, notification) and the balance reconciliation joins the existing akahu branch, but the download function is a fresh copy of downloadAkahuTransactions rather than a shared provider-download helper (none exists to call).

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the token/post/error/response-mapping block that the Pluggy.ai and Akahu downloads already repeat, adding another copy.

placement.why: Each piece sits where its siblings live: server-config base path, the link handler in accounts/app.ts, the download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, the account type under types/models.

scope.why: Server side only, exactly the pieces the request lists.

maintainability.why: Follows the established per-provider pattern and the shared link helper, so it is easy to own; the copied download body is the only extra burden.

bypasses_abstraction.where: None; linking uses linkBankSyncAccount and the balance logic reuses the akahu branch in processBankSyncDownload.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is an openly verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.
